title: Structure and Liftoff In Combustion Experiment
summary: SLICE investigated gas diffusion-flame structure and liftoff in ISS microgravity. This pending extraction contains 11 dated session summaries, not individual combustion tests; outcomes and run-level conditions are unavailable, and the CSV session explicitly labelled SPICE is excluded.
